description: This file defines an Android activity 'FragmentReceiveResult' with an inner fragment class 'ReceiveResultFragment' that demonstrates starting another activity for a result and handling the returned result. It manages fragment lifecycle, user interactions, and processing of activity results.

classes.name: FragmentReceiveResult
classes.description: An Android activity that hosts a fragment to demonstrate receiving activity results.

classes.name: ReceiveResultFragment
classes.description: A fragment responsible for starting another activity to get a result and processing that result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the fragment if not restored from saved state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Handles state saving for the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes the result display, and sets up the button to start activity for result.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the returned result from the started activity, updating the UI accordingly.
